title: Computational optimization of MASnI3 perovskite solar cells using SCAPS-1D simulations and machine learning techniques
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,1172-1192
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA07200J, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Benjer Islam, Tanvir Mahtab Khan, Md. Mountasir Rahaman, Sheikh Rashel Al Ahmed
We designed the MASnI3-based perovskite solar cell and investigated its performance using SCAPS-1D simulator and machine learning approaches. The maximum efficiency of 32.30% was obtained for the solar cell with WS2 as the ETL and Zn3P2 as the HTL.
